  • 英語名: Harukanaru Nirai Kanai

别名

  • The Far Away Nirai Kanai

あらすじ

On the eastern edge of this ocean, lies the Nirai Kanai.

Agarikata────

One of the eleven cities in Okinawa Prefecture, it is the only city that does not have police forces, instead, a vigilante group called Ookmiza, takes up their duties. But Ookmiza is just a front for the group, its members are made up of descendants of the Ryukyu Kingdom, which was dissolved in the past.

item.title: Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen -Ecole de Paris-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Navel
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 8.129999999999999/10 (622 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 乙女理論とその周辺 -Ecole de Paris-
  • 英語名: Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen -Ecole de Paris-

别名

  • 乙りろ

あらすじ

This is the sequel to Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou, taking place in Paris with imouto Resona as the main heroine. It continues from the bad ending in the original game, with Resona and Yuusei moving to Paris to attend École de Philia girl’s school after he could not longer attend the one in Japan. Once again he dresses up as the maid Asahi, although this time serving Resona. He gradually meets other girls there: the pure Meryl with promising talent, the welcoming ojousama Bluette, classmate Liliane, and fellow foreign student Dietlinde. Yuusei/Asahi chases after his dream, while Resona wishes for the courage to be independent. But can they achieve those goals in a difficult new world and their older brother possibly after them?

あらすじ

Yukito is waken up every morning by his cute osananajimi Yumeko. Normally one would feel blessed to be in such a situation, but she’s actually a mad scientist who wants to take over the world!
